brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the effect of exenatide on body weight and glycemic control in subjects with obesity and/or diabetes mellitus due to hypothalamic damage.
brief_title: Effects of Exenatide on Obesity and/or Diabetes Mellitus Due to Hypothalamic Damage
official_title: Effects of Exenatide on Obesity and/or Diabetes Mellitus Due to Hypothalamic Damage

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in body weight frome baseline to end of the study.
